boundaries: A real packaged renderer pointer/keyboard/context menus and original authenticated RPC. Original node-pty.spawn/write are passively observed on own instances, not replaced with simulated input or mode. Own wrapper execs actual /bin/zsh -d with isolated HOME/ZDOTDIR and a quoted-data ZLE snapshot widget, /bin/sh read loop, /bin/cat, no model. Explicit Ctrl-X Ctrl-T captures real ZLE BUFFER without accept/eval; extra observer bytes are separately asserted. sh/cat use noncanonical/no-echo TTY with ICRNL retained to avoid kernel canonical line-length caps. Malicious control text is a genuine UTF8-BOM file; ordinary unmarked control sample is correctly classified binary. Public IPC only isolated setup/teardown. No clipboard, DOM/editor value mutation, forged receipt or daily data.

P only: actual shared FileWorkspace mounted with labelled synthetic files, UI pointer/keyboard/menu/demo edits/deletion. State mounting and terminal response are explicitly synthetic P host setup, not App/native IO. No clipboard, physical IME or pixel-parity claim.

Y23 invalid traversal/drive/NUL references validated in P model and shared U; real macOS drive-shaped file is viewable but cannot be a terminal reference. Literal traversal/NUL names cannot be represented as a real file entry; no fabricated filesystem path.

Native raw-PTY I tests retain scoped RPC/real FileService and broker; synthetic Electron sender metadata is I, not GUI. Their independent expected output includes literal replacement char for lone surrogate; GUI BOM file is valid Unicode, not a claim that filesystem UTF8 can contain isolated UTF16 code units.

A ZLE widget only reads quoted actual buffer upon explicit control keys, never submits/evals content. sh Enter is actual CDP keyboard input to the own read loop after3seconds, not a physical IME or human-only system action.

Existing P design aligned to approved missing/size/stale rules; no new layout/visual design or full reference parity claim. Production/App hash and81runtime unchanged, no packaging or release. Other cases including H18/manual/system remain unchanged.
